g.text: Saved split-aggregate anchor at 2100 s (35 min) · 16 coordinates × six diagnostic protocols

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #334155

g.text: Slashes denote successive dwell currents and durations. Positive current discharges; negative current charges.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #334155

g.text: Reference increments (left): 1% fractional differential for 11 parameters; 1 SOC percentage point for z; 1 mV for each v; 0.01 for h.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #334155

g.text: Colour floor: 0.001 mV = 1 µV. Nonzero values below this floor share the lowest colour; their numerical values are unmodified and remain annotated.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #334155

g.text: Grey dashes are exact zero. Annotations are rounded display values; all underlying metrics and first figures are preserved.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: Peaks use the full declared 35 Hz diagnostic grid, including the initial point. State-conditioned forward predictions; no pre-anchor history recomputation.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: Display-only revision: no model or estimator calls, voltage assimilation, uncertainty-coverage claim, or continuous-time bound.
